headline: Haplotype-resolved long-read methylomes map epigenomic and telomeric variation
label: Epigenomic Diversity And Mutational Landscapes
summary: Long-read haplotype-resolved methylomes and cell type-resolved aging clocks now resolve epigenomic variation at population and cell-type scales.
synthesis: The dominant thread is how epigenomic and mutational states vary across haplotypes, individuals, tissues and cell types, and how that variation is quantified. TeloXplorer jointly profiles telomere length, variant repeats and DNA methylation at haplotype resolution from long reads, and the draft human panepigenome reports 440 haplotype-resolved methylomes across 26 populations, including CpGs absent from GRCh38. Aging work applies cell type-resolved chromatin accessibility clocks from snATAC-seq of 357 prefrontal cortex donors, and a TACIT-based analysis links lifespan to predicted open chromatin across 240 placental mammals. Replicative history is identified as a major determinant of epigenetic noise across tissues. Cross-species structural variant discovery and sequence-to-function modelling of cis-regulatory evolution extend this framing to primate and human evolution. Most items are preprints; the three published studies address eQTL architecture, polygenic trait networks and MDD-alcohol genetics rather than the same epigenomic layers.
